dos.text: Reach the outer browser window the same way getWindow() does (window.browsingContext.embedderWindowGlobal.browsingContext.window) rather than assuming this document's own window has SidebarController, since this header typically renders in an embedded document.

donts.text: Don't assume the close button always reveals the launcher, closeSidebarPanel's dismissPanel flag is computed from controller._state.launcherHiddenWithPanel, in hide-launcher mode it keeps the panel remembered instead of dismissing it since there's no launcher to return to.
